seo.title: Become the Answer — is your brand the one AI recommends?
seo.description: SEO got you found. AEO decides whether you're the answer AI gives. See where your brand stands, what invisibility costs, and how to win the AI shelf.

hero.headline: Search got you found. Answers decide if you're chosen.
hero.subhead: The sale is now decided the moment a buyer asks an AI agent for answers. Whoever gets named there wins, and that answer becomes the next buyer's starting point.

stakes.heading: Is AI recommending you, or your competitor?
stakes.body: You can be number one in search and absent from the answer. Ask an AI who to trust in your category, and three competitors come back, you were never in the running. Most brands have never even checked.

tool1.heading: Does AI recommend you, or your competitor?
tool1.microcopy: About 30 seconds · free · your score, share of voice, and the competitors winning your answers.
tool1.body: You can't fix what you can't see, and most brands have never looked. Run yours through the engines: enter your brand and category, and the AI Visibility Check asks the AI agents the questions your buyers ask, then scores whether you show up, or someone else takes your spot.

tool2.heading: When AI doesn't name you, someone else gets the sale.
tool2.subhead: Your AI Answer Index says how often you're the answer. This turns the gap into a number your CFO will recognise, the revenue moving to whoever AI recommends instead.

operatingSystem.heading: What's the difference between AEO and SEO?
operatingSystem.body: SEO ranks your page in a list of links. AEO makes you the single answer an AI gives. It reads your reviews, your mentions, what others say, then recommends one name. You compete to be quoted, not ranked.
operatingSystem.subheadingBody: AI trusts what other people say about you over what you say about yourself. It's word of mouth again, only now the machine is listening, and then doing the talking.

items.question: What is the difference between AEO and SEO?
items.answer: SEO optimises your pages to rank in a list of links a person then chooses from. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) optimises for AI assistants that read across your content, reviews and third-party sources and recommend one answer. SEO competes for a position; AEO competes to be the answer.

items.question: How do I know if AI recommends my brand?
items.answer: Run a free AI Visibility Check: enter your brand and category, and it asks ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude and Gemini the questions your buyers ask, then scores how often you appear versus competitors.

items.question: What does it cost a brand to be invisible in AI answers?
items.answer: It costs the deals shaped inside answers you never appear in. The Cost of Invisibility calculator estimates the annual pipeline you can't compete for, using your own buyer volume, deal size and close rate.

items.question: Why act now instead of waiting?
items.answer: AI assistants are forming their default recommendations while adoption is still early. Brands that earn their place now become the default answer; those defaults get harder to unseat over time.
